metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to highlight all 5 months of weekends by Ctrl+clicking individual cells. It successfully selected all June weekends (B6, B7, B13, B14, B20, B21, B27, B28) and began July, but ran out of turns (50) before finishing.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent can select spreadsheet cells, Ctrl+click multiple cells, and apply background colors via formatting toolbar.
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent failed to complete the full task (all 5 months) within 50 turns due to the tedious per-cell Ctrl+click approach. The reliable prefix covers all June weekends up to step ~5.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified from 5-month full task to June-only (8 cells), which the agent reliably demonstrated before failure. Cell addresses B6, B7, B13, B14, B20, B21, B27, B28 are verified from cache file.
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting red (#ff0000) background on all 8 June 2022 weekend cells (B6, B7, B13, B14, B20, B21, B27, B28). Evaluator checks each cell's fill fgColor.rgb == 'FFFF0000'. Partial credit: score = correct_cells / 8. Initial state has no fill (00000000) so negative control passes.

scoring_breakdown.each_cell: 1/8 per correctly colored cell (B6, B7, B13, B14, B20, B21, B27, B28)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts fgColor.rgb for all 8 target cells (B6, B7, B13, B14, B20, B21, B27, B28) from the xlsx file using openpyxl, which is the standard approach for reading LibreOffice-saved xlsx cell fill colors.
Metric correctly compares each cell's extracted color against the expected 'FFFF0000' (ARGB format for #ff0000 red with full opacity), using case-insensitive comparison.
All 8 June 2022 weekend cells are verified correct: June 4-5 (Sat-Sun)=B6-B7, June 11-12=B13-B14, June 18-19=B20-B21, June 25-26=B27-B28.
Negative control resistance is solid: initial state has no fill (returns '00000000'), which will not match 'FFFF0000', so an un-edited file correctly scores 0.
Partial credit scoring (correct_cells / 8) is semantically meaningful for a multi-cell coloring task.
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads from disk, ensuring fresh file state.
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict[cell_ref -> color_str], metric iterates target_cells checking against expected_color.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor robustness note: LibreOffice xlsx solid fill sometimes stores background in bgColor rather than fgColor for certain fill pattern types. If test failures occur, consider also checking fill.bgColor.rgb as a fallback when fgColor returns '00000000'.
